why: Owner, 2026-10-30: the code-drawn rooms (Midnight Gallery, Neon Vault, Zen Garden) are rejected: 'thats just blender like 3 quality running poorly on a phone ... I want you to have gemini and grok do it for you. Argon and grok can do it better if prompted correctly.' Each theme's room (the 'third place', away from the collection) becomes generated photography that the app brings to life with its own live light, particles, depth and sound. Pilot: three rooms; the other 47 follow once Joseph judges these on his phone.
global_style: Real photography: full-frame camera, 24 mm lens at eye height (about 1.6 m), level horizon, natural perspective, deep shadows that still hold detail, true reflections, physically accurate materials, practical light only, rich natural colour, fine film grain. It reads as a photograph in an architecture magazine, never as a video game, a 3D render or an illustration.
room_rule: This is a place to be in, seen from where a visitor stands: empty of people and of coins. The light sources stay inside the frame (the app makes them glow and flicker live), the air in the middle third stays open (the app adds live dust, rain, leaves and haze there), and nothing important sits within 8 % of the edges.
negative: no readable text, letters, numbers, logos or signs with words; no people, faces or hands; no coins; no watermark or frame; no 3D-render plastic look; no oversaturation or HDR halos; no fisheye or tilted horizon
instructions: Gemini: this one is yours (Joseph asked for you by name). Follow 'ART_START_HERE (any AI: images + video)'; claim it with artreq_20261030-1520_room-layers-gemini.CLAIMED-gemini.txt. For each room, in order: (1) make the wide photo from its prompt + the global_style sentence, 16:9, highest resolution; look at it and remake it (at most 3 tries) if it has letters, a person, a coin, a crooked horizon or looks like a render. (2) Then work FROM THAT SAME IMAGE with image editing, one edit per step, giving the image back to yourself each time, so every file lines up pixel for pixel: the edit prompts are in 'edits' below. Save every file to 'Titan Reliquary/art-incoming (AI images + video)/artreq_20261030-1520_room-layers-gemini/' with the exact names, at the size the tool returns (never upscale or crop), then write artreq_20261030-1520_room-layers-gemini.DONE.txt (one line per file: ok or skipped: reason; model name and date). One room at a time; stop at the first failure or quota warning and say how far you got. Save files in Drive only: Joseph cannot see your chat replies.

edits.upright: Using this image, make a 9:16 upright version of exactly the same place, light and moment, as if the photographer turned the camera to portrait: extend the scene above and below, keep every object, colour and light the same, add nothing new. Save as room_{id}_upright.png.
edits.depth: Using this image, make its depth map: the same framing and size, greyscale only, white for what is nearest the camera, black for the farthest, smooth gradients, sharp edges where objects end, no text and nothing else. Save as room_{id}_depth.png.
edits.lights: Using this image, make a light mask: the same framing and size, pure black everywhere except the light sources and the brightest light they throw (windows and moonbeams, lamps, bulbs, neon tubes, the sun and its glow), which are white with soft edges. Save as room_{id}_lights.png.
edits.foreground: Using this image, keep only the nearest object or surface ({foreground}) exactly where it is and replace everything else with pure flat green #00FF00. Save as room_{id}_front.png.
edits.clean_back: Using this image, remove {foreground} and fill that area naturally with what would be behind it, changing nothing else. Save as room_{id}_back.png.
